international.title: Fierce storm lashes southern California after record rain in San Francisco
international.summary: Atmospheric river first hit the north of the state, leaving tens of thousands of households without power An atmospheric river pounded southern California with heavy rain and winds, one day after the fierce storm set records for rainfall in the north of the state. Los Angeles authorities had urged residents in the Palisades, Hurst and Sunset burn scar areas to be prepared to leave before the storm’s arrival on Thursday, and warned of a risk of debris flows and flooding. Flash flood warnings were issued from Eastern Malibu to Beverly Hills to Hollywood, with heightened risk until noon on Thursday, while flood warnings were issued across the region through Thursday afternoon.
